evidence.quote: My topline assessment is that shrinking the balance sheet is a solvable challenge.
Loosely speaking, this range could reflect $1 trillion to $2 trillion of balance sheet reduction
It is therefore likely that a resumption of balance sheet reduction warrants additional reductions in the federal funds rate relative to baseline projections.
this process is likely to take well over a year once the decision is taken to proceed. It could take several years.
The most important thing we can do will be to go slowly. It is hard to overemphasize how important this is.

The net policy signal is roughly balanced, a mix of a tighter balance sheet and lower policy rates.
